column1: #@source motanka-qt6
#@packages motanka-qt6
# Upstream components of motanka-qt6, the Stack's Qt 6 on Ubuntu 24.04 and
# Same format as stack/components.tsv (see the comment there); build "qt"
# is a Qt submodule built by packaging/motanka-qt6/debian/qt6-build.sh, in
# file order, each against the ones before it. The package field names
# motanka-qt6; the build splits the files into motanka-qt6 (runtime) and
# motanka-qt6-dev (build files, never published) by path.
# design.md, "Qt for both releases": Upstream's shell declares
# `var native = ...`, which Qt's QML grammar accepts from 6.11 on. Both
# Ubuntu archives carry Qt 6.10.2, so every line is built for both suites
# (requirement 1.2), at Arch's version on 2026-11-13. qtimageformats adds
# the WebP and TIFF plugins: themes ship .webp backgrounds.
# Download, verify and pin: stack/fetch-sources --components stack/qt6-components.tsv
# name
qtbase
qtshadertools
qtsvg
qtdeclarative
qtwayland
qtimageformats
